Initial release of work-productivity-pollyreach-gives-workflow-helper.

- Provides practical workflows and decision aids for users needing PollyReach-style productivity enhancements.
- Supports bug fixing, setup hardening, safety, reliability, and adjacent workflow creation.
- Outputs tailored artifacts (checklists, templates, scripts) with a focus on local-hardware friendliness.
- Includes clear requirements restatement, success criteria, validation, and guidance for next steps.
